# SORIVA Packaging

> Custom luxury packaging manufacturer. Premium rigid boxes, magnetic gift boxes, drawer boxes, foldable rigid boxes, tube packaging and luxury paper bags for cosmetics, perfume, jewelry, candles, fashion and corporate gifts. Flexible MOQ, custom design and worldwide shipping.

## What we do

- Custom rigid box and magnetic gift box manufacturing
- Full customization: structure, paper, printing, finishing (foil stamping, embossing), inserts
- Fast prototyping with physical samples before bulk production
- Low MOQ options (from approximately 300 pcs for selected structures)
- Worldwide shipping to warehouse or fulfillment center
